style.backgroundSystem: two-field system held across the whole set: the fitting lives on cool light-grey studio plaster fields #EDEEF0 with matte plinth blocks #DDE0E4 and a white marble-veined sheet #F4F5F6, never a warm room tint; copy bands, spec cards and label rows sit on a muted lilac-grey band #C3C0D9 or on matte white cards #FFFFFF edged with hairline #C9CDD2; the near-black textured wall field #23262A is reserved only for screens where the luminaire is switched on; installed scenes use flat matte gypsum ceiling planes #F7F8F9
style.direction: premium diffuse-lighting detail-page commerce, cool plaster-studio system with physically correct light pools
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight 2px line glyphs only, #3F9C8E on light fields and #FFFFFF on dark fields; recurring frame furniture: rounded pill labels joined to the part by a hairline dot-leader, circular proof chips on white cards, two thin curved airflow glyphs used only as diagram, hairline #C9CDD2 dividers and dashed bracket tick rules carrying no numerals
style.lightingSystem: bright soft neutral-cool 6500K key from the upper left with a large white bounce on the shadow side, gentle gradient falloff, soft contact shadow grounding the fitting, one continuous specular run along each die-cast fin and one crisp highlight line along the chamfered bevel; whenever the product is switched on the light must land as a physically plausible pool on a wall or floor with a defined edge and orderly falloff, the fitting body itself staying dim and readable, never a glowing disc, halo, bloom or star flare
